_note: Repo-local pricing plan. Apify does NOT read this file: prices are entered in Apify Console > Publication > Monetization (actor.json has no pricing field - verified against the official actor.json schema in @apify/json_schemas). It exists so scripts can cross-check that every event the code charges is declared here, and that priceUsd >= 5 x estimatedCostUsd (CONVENTIONS.md, pricing rule).
